tools.name: about_noga
tools.description: Overview of NOGA Movement: what it offers, pricing basics, and key links.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Lists every bookable NOGA live class and private session (readings, mentorship) with price, length and description.

tools.name: get_class_schedule
tools.description: Returns upcoming live NOGA classes with times (Eastern), spots left, price, and the ids needed to book.

tools.name: book_class
tools.description: Holds a spot in a live NOGA class for a person and returns a nogamovement.com checkout link they use to confirm and pay (or apply a pack or membership). Requires the class's service_id and event_id from get_class_schedule, and the person's first name and email.

tools.name: get_session_times
tools.description: Returns open times for a private session with Laurie, such as an Integrated Chart Reading, 10 Minute Astrology, 10 Minute Human Design, Cosmic Conversations or Mentorship.

tools.name: book_session
tools.description: Holds a private session time and returns a nogamovement.com checkout link the person uses to confirm and pay. Requires service_id, start and end from get_session_times, and the person's first name and email.

tools.name: get_teacher_trainings
tools.description: Returns details of the Pilates+ Mat Teacher Certification (price, what's included, enroll link) and the NOGA Foundation and Define Barre trainings.

tools.name: find_pilates_plus_instructor
tools.description: Searches the official directory of Pilates+ certified instructors by city or state, or for ones who teach online.

tools.name: verify_pilates_plus_instructor
tools.description: Checks whether a person is a Pilates+ certified instructor with an active listing in the official directory.
